Shibboleth
The robust, university-wide authentication and authorization system utilized by
RIT. SISCalendar relies on this external security system to rigorously verify a
user's identity and credentials before granting them access to the application's
core Schedule Subsystem.
iCal4j
A dedicated, third-party Java library integrated directly into the SISCalendar
Business Services layer. It is explicitly responsible for transforming the internal
POJO data structures into a universally standardized iCal format, ultimately
enabling the system to create downloadable .ics calendar files for the end-user.
ANT
Apache ANT is a highly reliable Java-based build tool and scripting library
utilized extensively by the development team. It automates the complex
compilation and deployment processes, seamlessly converting the raw Struts
application source code into deployable Web Application Archive (.war) files
for the Apache Tomcat servers.
Struts 2
An enterprise-grade Model-View-Controller (MVC) framework published by
Apache. It serves as the architectural backbone of the SISCalendar
application, providing out-of-the-box "action" controller classes that handle
logic execution and route processed data directly to the view layers.
